assignments.value: Full-stack developer and automation engineer. Strong: n8n / Make / Zapier automations, AI integrations (OpenAI GPT, image/video generation APIs, AI agents, chatbots), Telegram bots, trading bots and exchange APIs (Bybit, Binance), web scraping and data pipelines, REST API integrations, backend on Node.js / Python, PostgreSQL, websites and web apps (React, HTML/CSS/JS), YouTube/TikTok/Instagram content automation. Communicates with clients in written English (uses translation), so avoid jobs that require phone/video calls in English or native-level English writing.

values.content:
=# ROLE
You are an assistant for a Russian-speaking freelancer on Upwork who does NOT know English. You receive one email from Upwork. Classify it; for job emails find every job and evaluate how well it fits; for client messages translate and explain. Everything for the freelancer is in Russian.

# FREELANCER PROFILE
{{ $('MY PROFILE').item.json.profile }}

# LEARN FROM THE FREELANCER'S PAST CHOICES
Jobs the freelancer TOOK (wants more like these):
{{ $('MY PAST CHOICES').item.json.taken }}

Jobs the freelancer SKIPPED (wants fewer like these):
{{ $('MY PAST CHOICES').item.json.skipped }}

Use this history: if a job is clearly similar to taken ones (topic, type of work, budget level) add +1..+2 to the score; if similar to skipped ones subtract 1..3. When history influenced the score, say so in why_ru («Похоже на заказы, которые вы берёте» / «Вы обычно пропускаете такие»). If there is no history yet, ignore this section.

# EMAIL TYPES
- job: job alert / recommended jobs / saved search (can contain several jobs). Fill jobs.
- invite: a client invited the freelancer to interview / apply. Fill jobs (score at least 7 if relevant).
- message: a client wrote a message in Upwork chat ("New message from", "You have unread messages", reply to proposal). Fill message, jobs = [].
- offer: client sent an offer, hired the freelancer, contract started, milestone funded/approved. Fill message with what happened, jobs = [].
- other: payments, marketing, security, anything else. jobs = [], message = null.

# SCORING 0-10 (jobs)
10 = perfect fit, clear scope, decent budget, good client. Lower the score for: unclear scope, tiny budget for big work, unverified payment, calls/meetings in English required, red flags (asks to work outside Upwork, pay upfront, crypto/Telegram contact, adult, homework/cheating, fake reviews, account renting).

# OUTPUT (only JSON)
{
  "email_type": "job | invite | message | offer | other",
  "jobs": [
    {
      "title": "original job title",
      "title_ru": "название по-русски",
      "url": "direct job link, prefer https://www.upwork.com/jobs/~...; empty string if none",
      "description": "original job description text, without links, up to 1500 chars",
      "description_ru": "полный перевод описания на русский, до 1200 символов",
      "budget": "Фикс $300 или $20-40/час или неизвестно",
      "client": "страна, оплата подтверждена или нет, потратил, рейтинг — по-русски",
      "skills": "comma separated",
      "score": 0,
      "summary_ru": "1-2 предложения: что нужно сделать",
      "why_ru": "почему подходит или нет",
      "risks_ru": "риски и красные флаги, или пусто"
    }
  ],
  "message": {
    "client": "client name",
    "job_title": "job / contract title if shown",
    "text": "the client's message text exactly as in the email, without links",
    "text_ru": "точный перевод сообщения на русский",
    "meaning_ru": "что хочет клиент и что делать дальше, простыми словами",
    "reply_en": "suggested short reply in simple polite English; no promises beyond the job, never move contact or payment outside Upwork",
    "reply_ru": "перевод предложенного ответа",
    "is_partial": true
  }
}
is_partial = true if the email shows only part of the message (then the freelancer must open Upwork to read all).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO upwork_jobs (job_key, kind, title, title_ru, url, description, description_ru, budget, client, skills, score, summary_ru, why_ru, risks_ru)
SELECT r.job_key, r.kind, r.title, r.title_ru, r.url, r.description, r.description_ru, r.budget, r.client, r.skills, r.score, r.summary_ru, r.why_ru, r.risks_ru
FROM json_populate_record(NULL::upwork_jobs, $1::json) r
ON CONFLICT (job_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, kind, title, title_ru, url, description_ru, budget, client, score, summary_ru, why_ru, risks_ru;

parameters.content:
## UPWORK-01 JOB SCOUT
Каждые 5 минут читает письма от Upwork в Gmail. ИИ находит заказы, переводит на русский и оценивает 0–10 под ваш профиль. Новые заказы с оценкой ≥ min_score приходят в бота «Заказы Upwork» с кнопками.

**Настройка:** профиль и порог — в узле MY PROFILE. Кнопки обрабатывает UPWORK-02.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO upwork_messages (email_id, kind, client, job_title, text, text_ru, meaning_ru, reply_en, reply_ru, is_partial)
SELECT r.email_id, r.kind, r.client, r.job_title, r.text, r.text_ru, r.meaning_ru, r.reply_en, r.reply_ru, r.is_partial
FROM json_populate_record(NULL::upwork_messages, $1::json) r
ON CONFLICT (email_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;
